title: What are the major diseases of mango?
content: Mango trees are affected by several diseases such as anthracnose, powdery mildew, dieback, bacterial canker, and gummosis. These diseases hinder plant growth and significantly reduce yield.

title: What is anthracnose disease in mango?
content: Anthracnose is a fungal disease of mango that causes black spots on leaves, branches, and fruits. It leads to fruit rot and premature fruit drop, reducing overall yield.
